confianca.question: Why would I trust an AI instead of a human?
confianca.answer: Because AI has no ego. It doesn't get lazy. It doesn't just "not feel like it". It executes the strategic work, based on data, 100% of the months. It was trained by top-tier experts, so you don't have to pay their salary.

preco.question: Isn't my plan starting at R$ 297/month too cheap? What's the catch?
preco.answer: It's not cheap, it's efficient. Our cost structure is radically leaner: no expensive offices, no bloated layers of directors. We pass that savings on to you. The only "catch" is you'll wonder why you paid so much for so long.

agenciaAtual.question: What if I already have an agency?
agenciaAtual.answer: Perfect. Take the 7-Day Challenge in secret. Compare what we deliver in one week with what they delivered last month. The decision becomes obvious.

trafegoPago.question: Is the paid ad spend included?
trafegoPago.answer: No. Your subscription fee and your paid ad spend are separate. You set your own budget for Google and Meta ads, and it's 100% yours, with no middleman from our team.
